system.description:
Your natural regeneration can help you recuperate from wounds more quickly.

Prerequisite: Trandoshan

Effect: Once per day when you catch a Second Wind, you can regain no Hit Points immediately and instead regain 5 Hit Points at the end of each of your turns until you reach full Hit Points or until the end of the encounter (whichever comes first).

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
